player_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_api_id,
        p.player_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pp.result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pp.result = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as loss_count
    FROM player_participations pp
    JOIN Player p ON pp.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
),
top_win AS (
    SELECT player_name, CAST(win_count AS INTEGER) as match_count
    FROM player_stats
    ORDER BY win_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
top_loss AS (
    SELECT player_name, CAST(loss_count AS INTEGER) as match_count
    FROM player_stats
    ORDER BY loss_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 'highest_winning' as category, tw.player_name, tw.match_count
FROM top_win tw
UNION ALL
SELECT 'highest_losing' as category, tl.player_name, tl.match_count
FROM top_loss tl
